1890.s: In like manner Andromache, grieving at their departure, gave to Ascanius a vestment trimmed with gold, a Phrygian cloak and products of her own skill at the loom, saying: "Take these, my boy, as memorials of my handiwork, and let them testify to the lasting love of Andromache, who was once the faithful wife of Hector."

1900.s: When she appeared at the end of the play, in short tunic, red cloak and Phrygian cap, carrying a banner of the colours adopted by the local insurrection, they thought better of their indifference, and the Marseillaise produced the same effect as upon us.
